testing_mode: RED

## Story DD Coverage
Testing foundation for DD4 (ref-query.sh + ref-query.py exist and pass).

## Context
Write failing pytest tests for the BM25 reference query script before it exists. All tests use tmp_path fixture corpus — never the live corpus. BM25 oracles use ranking-order assertions (result A ranks before result B), never score-equality assertions. ref-query.py uses stdlib Python BM25 (no new dependency). Tests must FAIL at end of task.

## Test File
tests/scripts/test_ref_query.py

## .test-index Entry Required
tests/scripts/test_ref_query.py -> plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py

## Test Cases (≥6)
1. Basic query against fixture corpus returns ≤N results (tmp_path, not live corpus)
2. BM25 ranking-order oracle: entry with exact keyword match ranks before entry without it
3. --tier filter returns only entries matching that tier value
4. --top-n N limits output to exactly N results
5. --session-hash value appears in output metadata
6. Query with no matches: zero results, error message to stderr (not stdout)
7. Performance: query against 20-entry fixture corpus completes in <10s

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ≥6 test cases using tmp_path only (fixture corpus), never live corpus
- [ ] BM25 oracles use ranking assertions (rank comparisons), never score equality
- [ ] All tests FAIL (ref-query.py does not exist yet)
- [ ] .test-index entry registered: tests/scripts/test_ref_query.py -> plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py
- [ ] BM25 implementation to be stdlib Python only — no new dependency (no rank_bm25, no bm25s)

## Given/When/Then
GIVEN ref-query.py does not exist
WHEN the test suite runs test_ref_query.py
THEN all tests fail with ImportError or FileNotFoundError

## Retry Budget: 3
data.title: RED: Write failing tests for ref-query.py (ranking-order BM25 oracle, fixture-based)
